cases.title: One ERP instead of eleven spreadsheets
cases.challenge: Orders, stock and invoices lived in separate spreadsheets across three warehouses, so nobody trusted the numbers.
cases.built: A custom ERP with sales, purchasing, multi-warehouse inventory, accounting and role-based dashboards, plus a mobile app for pickers.
cases.outcome: Every department works from one live database, and month-end closing moved from a manual scramble to a report.

cases.title: Point of sale that keeps working offline
cases.challenge: A growing retail chain needed checkout, stock and staff management that works in every shop, even when the internet drops.
cases.built: An offline-first POS for tablets, central inventory with branch transfers, and an owner dashboard for sales by shop and product.
cases.outcome: Shops sell without interruptions and stock syncs automatically when the connection returns.

cases.title: An assistant that answers from the docs
cases.challenge: The support team answered the same product questions every day from a large, scattered knowledge base.
cases.built: An AI assistant inside the existing product that answers from the company docs with citations and hands off to a human when unsure.
cases.outcome: Common questions get instant answers, and the team spends its time on the conversations that need a person.
